review: Independent public-site and image-provenance source review before publication
scope: Reviewed current on-disk policy/support Markdown, generator, generated HTML, static headers/config, event-only Analytics.log change, provenance document and application receipt. No product/source changes, deployment, account changes or commits performed by this reviewer.

findings.fact: Policy says Game Center is available only in builds explicitly enabling it. Current enabled is !TestSupport.isAutomated; there is no release gate yet.
findings.minimal_fix: Land and verify the intended default-off gate before publishing this sentence, or describe existing behavior accurately. Do not call the gate fixed based on policy text alone.

findings.fact: The broad 'chart contents are not uploaded' guarantee conflicts with the optional picker automatically using chartTitle plus chartArtist as its initial search term. Full chart text/audio are not sent through this path, but chart metadata is transmitted to Apple after the user opens the picker.
findings.minimal_fix: Say imported audio and full chart text are kept local; choosing the Apple Music finder can send the chart title/artist as a search query, along with any search terms the user enters. Qualify both policy and support storage guarantees consistently.

findings.fact: Notifications are locally scheduled, but 'nothing about them is sent anywhere' is false: reminder_ask analytics carries the result and chosen minutes.
findings.minimal_fix: State that reminder delivery is local and does not use a developer push-notification server; when analytics is enabled, a reminder setup event can include the choice/time. Alternatively remove the telemetry property/event in a separately reviewed product change.

findings.fact: 'At most once a day' overstates the fetch throttle. fetchedAt is set only after a successful status/parse; failures can be retried on later refresh calls. A different storefront bypasses the interval too.
findings.minimal_fix: Use 'normally refreshed once a day for a storefront; failed requests or a storefront change may cause another request' or simply omit the claimed strict frequency.

findings.fact: Policy acknowledges already-started network operations may finish, which accurately limits in-flight telemetry behavior. However Apple Ads attribution can initiate additional retry HTTP requests after opt-out because sharing is checked only before detached work starts. That differs from merely finishing a request already started.
findings.minimal_fix: Apply the separately planned retry cancellation/recheck fix before publishing a broad stop-new-uploads guarantee. No additional promise to erase already-received events should be introduced.

findings.fact: Receipt preserves the owner's supplied statement and exactly identifies all 68 previously provided entries. Before and after manifest hashes match raw bytes. But the per-image sha256 fields are inherited manifest source hashes: 66 of 68 bundled PNGs have different actual byte hashes; all 68 bundled files exist. 'Existing image hashes bind this record to the supplied files' must not be read as verification of all shipped image bytes.
findings.minimal_fix: Label existing sha256 as original manifest/source hashes and record separate computed bundled-file hashes/paths if binding the receipt to shipped images. Preserve source hashes rather than replacing them with derivative hashes. State source-original bytes were not independently matched in this review. Asset IDs plus the owner attestation remain useful provenance evidence; no fabrication of generation service or third-party license is needed.

findings.fact: The revised no-precise-location statement is technically compatible with the current countryOrRegion forwarding. The enumerated attribution fields still omit country/region.
findings.minimal_fix: Explicitly name campaign country/region if it remains transmitted, or remove that property as planned. Avoid saying the property has already been removed.

findings.fact: Imported audio copies are deliberately marked excluded from backup, while the policy gives only a general device-backups sentence. The site README still describes manual GitHub Pages publishing and does not explain the new Cloudflare static build/deploy workflow.
findings.minimal_fix: Mention imported audio copies are excluded from device/iCloud backup and keep originals. Update publication instructions to the actual static build, deploy and verification flow; document GitHub Pages as legacy if retained.

passed_checks.markdown_html_parity: Both public/privacy.html and public/support.html main elements exactly contain current marked.parse output from their respective source Markdown. Both legacy docs/site HTML files byte-match public outputs.
passed_checks.static_content: No script tag, external asset request, form, analytics embed or user-input rendering found in generated pages. Markdown inputs are trusted repository files, so marked raw HTML support is not an exposed remote-input path here.
passed_checks.headers: Generated _headers includes restrictive default-src none, inline styles only, base-uri none, form-action none, frame-ancestors none, nosniff, no-referrer and camera/microphone/geolocation disabled. Headers need live response verification after deployment; legacy HTML copies do not themselves carry these HTTP headers.
passed_checks.deployment_configuration: wrangler.jsonc points only to public static assets with no Worker main script or paid bindings. No deployment was performed or claimed. Cloudflare hosting statement becomes true on that deployment; it should not be presented as the current old GitHub host's provider.
passed_checks.analytics_log: Analytics.log now writes only the event name to public OS logging, eliminating property-value logging at that call site. Queued events still include properties for telemetry; the change is not an opt-out/cancellation fix.
passed_checks.microphone: Microphone-specific local/in-memory/no-recording wording remains supported by reviewed audio paths. Distinguishing deliberate audio imports avoids an incorrect global no-stored-recordings guarantee.
passed_checks.provenance_scope: 68 receipt records exactly match the baseline entries having origin provided; asset/source/sha256 other than origin are unchanged for all manifest entries. Five other existing origin records remain outside the owner's 68-entry attestation.

not_claimed_fixed: Song-request truthfulness when analytics is unavailable
limits: This is a source/content and static artifact review. Parent-supplied browser/axe results were not independently rerun. This report does not certify legal compliance, native assistive-technology behavior or live service configuration. Findings reflect files read during this review; recheck after other agents land pending fixes.
